entries.name: MOCCA2 Web App
entries.summary: Open-source self-hosted web application for automated HPLC chromatogram processing: it accepts raw data files from Agilent, Shimadzu and Waters instruments, performs baseline correction and adaptive peak picking, uses calibration standards and internal standards to calculate concentrations, and saves chromatograms, processing settings and processed results in a restorable campaign. MIT-licensed.
features: raw chromatogram import from Agilent, Shimadzu and Waters files
automatic baseline correction and adaptive peak picking
campaign save/load with chromatograms, processing settings and results
interactive chromatogram and concentration result views
deployment: self-hosted web application (Dash, served on localhost)

leaf_matches.reason: The official README documents a browser-based, self-hosted HPLC processing application with its own Data, Process and Results pages rather than a desktop client or bare library: raw Agilent/Shimadzu/Waters files are loaded and named by sample, baseline correction and peak picking are performed, calibration standards and internal standards produce calibrated concentrations, and the campaign stores chromatograms, processing settings and processed results for later restoration. That covers the CDS core in a complete web application form; it does not claim instrument control, audit trails or multi-user enterprise features.
